assessment: This study investigates the processes by which HLJ1, a molecular chaperone in the heat shock protein 40 family, regulates mononuclear phagocyte processing and release of active IL-12 in response to a endotoxin. Specifically, in the liver, LPS induced HJL1-regulated secretion of active IL-12 that in turn stimulates CTL and NK cells to produce IFN culminating in endotoxin shock.
